item.title: The Trump Administration Needs To Be Overthrown
item.description: by Anonymous This is a rage post so I'll keep it short. ICE arresting and holding Oglala Sioux tribal members is just one of many steps too far by this administration. The tribal leaders do not, under any circumstances, have to comply with ICE for anything. And they certainly don't need to sign an 'immigration agreement' to be able to find out what happened to their detained loved ones. This is beyond ridiculous.

item.title: City Council Elects Jamie Dunphy as New President
item.description: Jeremiah Hayden by Jeremiah Hayden Technically, Portland City Council finally adjourned a meeting that began January 7 on January 14, after it elected Jamie Dunphy to serve as its president for 2026.
